ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast with approximately 75% high-intensity pixels (white) and 25% low-intensity pixels (black) localized to the central peduncle and distal edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, contiguous white geometric fields occupy the primary area of each lobe, bifurcated by a dark, vertical Y-shaped band originating at the peduncle and extending to the notch; dark pigmentation is also present in irregular mottling along the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 55-60 degrees at the central vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations present along the entire trailing edge boundary; prominent jagged irregularities on the distal third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve intersecting with convex leading edge curve to form acute, upwardly-tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple punctate dark spots (mottling) scattered across the high-intensity white fields, with a higher cluster density visible on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 3-4 parallel, vertical dark linear disruptions (rake marks) visible on the distal upper region of the right lobe's ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small irregular notches and tissue loss along the trailing edge consistent with historical trauma; distinct rake marks on the right fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Suspended water droplets and spray pattern visible in the air column directly above the fluke tips and notch.
